verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a state filing agency with an online filing system has some sign-in path. However, nothing in the pack describes how users authenticate, whether by credential MFA, ID.me-style biometric liveness, in-person proofing, or mailed PIN. The docs only confirm that an online filing rail exists, and the probe of the filing host (filings.dos.ny.gov) failed at the transport layer, so no sign-in documentation was observed.
